TableForeignKeyConstraint = 64

Add or drop a foreign key constraint, e.g.

alter table {TableName} add constraint {ConstraintName} foreign key ({ColumnName}) references {ForeignTableName} ({ForeignColumnName})

CAUTION: For use with a ALTER TABLE statement only.

NOTE: All databases support foreign key constraint in the CREATE TABLE statement.

TableUniqueConstraint = 32

Add or drop a unique constraint, e.g

alter table {TableName} add constraint {ConstraintName} unique ({ColumnName})

CAUTION: For use with a ALTER TABLE statement only.

NOTE: All databases support unique constraint in the CREATE TABLE statement.
